# Contributing

Thanks for wanting to help with Klovy Chat.

## How to contribute

1. Fork the repository you want to change ([backend](https://github.com/klovy-chat/backend), [frontend](https://github.com/klovy-chat/frontend), [website](https://github.com/klovy-chat/website), or [application](https://github.com/klovy-chat/application)).
2. Create a branch: `git checkout -b feature/short-description`
3. Make your changes. Do not commit `.env`, secrets, keys, or real credentials.
4. Open a pull request against `main` and describe **what** changed and **why**.

Small fixes (docs, typos, translations) are welcome.

## Security

Do not file a public issue for a vulnerability. See [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md).
